item.title: Bestselling Author, Screenwriter to Deliver LitFest Keynote
item.description: The community is invited to hear bestselling author and screenwriter Blake Crouch deliver the Highland Park Literary Festival keynote speech on Feb. 19 at Highland Park High School.

item.title: Bears Bound For College Ranks
item.description: Eight Ursuline athletes finalized their collegiate plans Wednesday when they participated in National Signing Day.

item.title: One Last Run: Young Wrapping Up Storied Career
item.description: When the playoffs conclude for Highland Park’s girls basketball team sometime this month, it will signify the end of the playing career of Cate Young.

item.title: Coach Mark Stout Trumpets W.T. White Softball
item.description: Mark Stout has been a trumpet player for much longer than he’s been a softball coach. These days, he admits he’s much more of the latter than the former.

item.title: Park Cities Crime Reports Feb. 2-8
item.description: Car thieves, criminal cruisers, and crooks ran amok in the Park Cities in this week's Crime Reports.

item.title: Old School Barbershop Makes Way for New Development
item.description: For 90 years, the Village Barbershop delivered old school cuts, free of any fancy frills but with lots of friendly conversation, to customers in Highland Park Village.

item.title: Letter to the Editor: A Sad Cut
item.description: Given the Highland Park Village’s drive to have only haute couture designer brands for women, it seemed a matter of time that the Village Barber Shop would be swept away.

item.title: Dashboard to Boost Police Department Transparency
item.description: The City of Dallas has unveiled a new public-facing tool aimed at giving residents clearer insight into police oversight and accountability efforts.

item.title: Teens, Adults Help Catch Up and Read Close Literacy Gap
item.description: In 2009, the organization founded by philanthropist Catherine LeBlanc was founded to equip children in underserved communities to read on grade level by the end of third grade.
